interface: Cursor Agent CLI noninteractive print mode
sandbox_windows_note: Agent CLI 2026.09.15-d2fe57e rejects --sandbox enabled on Windows (macOS/Linux only). Do not persist sandbox disable.
notes: cursor.cmd is the IDE launcher, not the agent CLI.
Missing or unauthenticated agent CLI must return BLOCKED with failure_class AUTH_REQUIRED or CLI_MISSING, never COMPLETED.
Do not invoke cmd.exe or powershell with a caller-supplied command string.
--trust is headless workspace trust for an already-approved repo. It is not all-drive access.
--force is used only for authorized A1 writes. Read-only jobs use --mode ask.
A2/A3 remain owner-gated. Routine A1 work under personal roots does not re-prompt and does not require a per-repo allowlist entry.
approved_repo_names and catalog_repo_names are descriptive. Authorization is personal roots minus the deny list.
The Workspace drive root is not itself a Cursor workspace because it contains excluded trees.
